query: what is the university of washington's undergraduate tuition for washington residents?

results.title: Estimated Annual Cost of Attendance for First-Year Undergraduates | Tuition & Fees
results.snippet: The following table shows the estimated expenses for the 2026-27 academic year for first-year undergraduate students at the University of Washington’s three campuses, as approved by the UW Board of Regents in June 2026. It reflects student fees and budgets for the regular academic year: fall, winter, and spring. Note: the state’s allowable resident undergraduate tuition increase (under RCW 28B.15.067) for the 2026-27 academic year is 3.3%. This is applicable only to resident undergraduate tuition.

results.title: University of Washington Tuition & Cost 2026-27: What UW Actually Costs Families - CollegeClearly
results.snippet: The University of Washington's 2026-27 undergraduate tuition & fees are $14,340 for Washington residents and $46,256 for out-of-state. Estimated cost of attendance: $37,680 resident, $69,596 nonresident. The Husky Promise makes tuition free for eligible Washington residents.
